title: The Parable of the Vine and Jerusalem's Judgment
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel with a parable about the vine: wood from a grapevine is useless for making anything, and once it has been burned by fire, it is even more worthless. Thus says the Lord God, He has given the inhabitants of Jerusalem to the fire. Even if they escape from the fire, the fire will still consume them. The Lord turns His face against them and makes the land a desolate waste because they have been unfaithful [ref:Esek 15:1-8|Ezekiel 15:1-8].
